parameters.jsCode:
const submittedAt = new Date($json.submitted_at);
const completedAt = new Date();

const totalLatencyMs = completedAt - submittedAt;

const slaTargetMs = 300000; // 5 mins

const slaBreached = totalLatencyMs > slaTargetMs;

const latencySeconds =
  Math.floor(totalLatencyMs / 1000);

const latencyMinutes =
  (totalLatencyMs / 1000 / 60).toFixed(2);

return [
{
  json: {

    claim_id:
      $json.claim_id,

    internal_claim_id:
      $json.internal_claim_id,

    metric_date:
      completedAt.toISOString().split('T')[0],

    metric_timestamp:
      completedAt.toISOString(),

    submitted_at:
      submittedAt.toISOString(),

    completed_at:
      completedAt.toISOString(),

    total_latency_ms:
      totalLatencyMs,

    latency_seconds:
      latencySeconds,

    latency_minutes:
      Number(latencyMinutes),

    sla_target_ms:
      slaTargetMs,

    sla_breached:
      slaBreached,

    claim_status:
      $json.claim_status || 'UNKNOWN',

    fraud_score:
      $json.fraud_score || 0,

    confidence_score:
      $json.confidence_score || 0,

    recommended_payout:
      $json.recommended_payout || 0,

    route_taken:
      $json.route_taken || 'UNKNOWN'

  }
}
];
